integrity: General counterexample family proved by an explicit nested-ceiling construction and two disjoint congruences; all six five-element expansions exhaustively classified by their convex congruence masks; tests replay exact original axioms on sizes two through five.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite totally ordered F-preconditional algebra expansions in the full conditional signature. Five is the first size admitting failure of subdirect irreducibility; counts at all larger sizes and other lattice carriers remain unresolved.
title: The five-element threshold for non-subdirectly-irreducible preconditional chains
